q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ house across the road is new.

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: There are ___ apples in the basket.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: There are ___ apples in the basket.

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ of the two roads leads to the town.

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ of them agreed to the plan.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: ___ of them agreed to the plan.

explanation.en: None means not one of a group of more than two.
explanation.as: None ৰ অৰ্থ দুটাতকৈ অধিক গোটৰ এটাও নহয়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: She has ___ friends in the city.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: She has ___ friends in the city.

explanation.en: A few is used with countable plural nouns, meaning some.
explanation.as: A few বহুবচন গণনীয় বিশেষ্যৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, অৰ্থাৎ কিছু।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: We have ___ time left before the train leaves.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: We have ___ time left before the train leaves.

explanation.en: A little is used with the uncountable noun time, meaning some.
explanation.as: A little অগণনীয় বিশেষ্য time ৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, অৰ্থাৎ কিছু।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ student in the class was given a prize.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: ___ student in the class was given a prize.

explanation.en: Each with a singular noun means every one taken separately.
explanation.as: Each এ একবচন বিশেষ্যৰ সৈতে প্ৰতিটোক বেলেগে বুজায়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: He has ___ information about the event.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: He has ___ information about the event.

explanation.en: Much is used with the uncountable noun information.
explanation.as: Much অগণনীয় বিশেষ্য information ৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: There were ___ people at the fair.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: There were ___ people at the fair.

explanation.en: A great many is used with countable plural nouns like people.
explanation.as: A great many বহুবচন গণনীয় বিশেষ্যৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়, যেনে people।

q.en: Choose the correct article: He is ___ MBA graduate.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: He is ___ MBA graduate.

explanation.en: MBA begins with the vowel sound 'em', so an is used.
explanation.as: MBA এ স্বৰ ধ্বনি 'em' ৰে আৰম্ভ হয়, গতিকে an ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: She waited for ___ hour.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: She waited for ___ hour.

explanation.en: Hour begins with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so an is used.
explanation.as: Hour এ স্বৰ ধ্বনিৰে আৰম্ভ হয় (h নীৰৱ), গতিকে an ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: ___ Bay of Bengal lies to the south.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: ___ Bay of Bengal lies to the south.

explanation.en: The is used before the names of seas and bays.
explanation.as: সাগৰ আৰু উপসাগৰৰ নামৰ আগত The ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: He is ___ only son of his father.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: He is ___ only son of his father.

explanation.en: The is used before only when it means the single one.
explanation.as: যেতিয়া only য়ে একমাত্ৰ বুজায়, তেতিয়া The ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: She wants to be ___ engineer.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: She wants to be ___ engineer.

explanation.en: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, so an is used.
explanation.as: Engineer এ স্বৰ ধ্বনিৰে আৰম্ভ হয়, গতিকে an ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: ___ Pacific is the largest ocean.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: ___ Pacific is the largest ocean.

explanation.en: The is used before the names of oceans.
explanation.as: মহাসাগৰৰ নামৰ আগত The ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: I have ___ headache.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: I have ___ headache.

explanation.en: Headache is a countable noun and takes a.
explanation.as: Headache এটা গণনীয় বিশেষ্য আৰু ই a লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ of the answers was correct.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: ___ of the answers was correct.

explanation.en: Neither is used when none of two is meant, taking a singular verb.
explanation.as: Neither যেতিয়া দুটাৰ এটাও নহয় বুজায়, তেতিয়া একবচন ক্ৰিয়া লয়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: There is ___ milk in the pot.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: There is ___ milk in the pot.

explanation.en: A little is used with the uncountable noun milk.
explanation.as: A little অগণনীয় বিশেষ্য milk ৰ সৈতে ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: He gave me ___ ten-rupee note.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: He gave me ___ ten-rupee note.

explanation.en: A is used before a singular countable noun mentioned for the first time.
explanation.as: প্ৰথমবাৰ উল্লেখ কৰা একবচন গণনীয় বিশেষ্যৰ আগত a ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct article: ___ Himalayas protect India from cold winds.
q.as: শুদ্ধ article বাছনি কৰা: ___ Himalayas protect India from cold winds.

explanation.en: The is used before the names of mountain ranges.
explanation.as: পৰ্বতমালাৰ নামৰ আগত The ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: ___ boy in the team played well.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: ___ boy in the team played well.

explanation.en: Every with a singular noun means all the members one by one.
explanation.as: Every এ একবচন বিশেষ্যৰ সৈতে সকলো সদস্যক এটাকৈ বুজায়।

q.en: Choose the correct determiner: I have read ___ of these books.
q.as: শুদ্ধ determiner বাছনি কৰা: I have read ___ of these books.

explanation.en: Some is used with a countable plural noun to mean a few of them.
explanation.as: Some বহুবচন গণনীয় বিশেষ্যৰ সৈতে কিছু বুজাবলৈ ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।
